definitions: Used to indicate that a preceding play on words was unintentional or to acknowledge a pun that was made, often humorously.
A phrase used to disclaim any intention of making a pun, especially when a statement could be interpreted as one.
examples: I'm trying to get my life back on track, no pun intended.
That presentation was really illuminating, no pun intended.
The chef's new dish is a real hit, no pun intended.
We need to iron out the details, no pun intended.
